01

matte-toybox-playworld

A full-bleed matte 3D toy world you inhabit — walk, drive, fly at eye level instead of scrolling — hue and silhouette separating objects, candy grading per zone, UI shrunk to a white sticker layer.

Signature move You walk, not scroll: the keyboard drives a character over a ~40-unit tiny planet (camera 1 up, 5 back); idle damping 0.65 per 60 Hz frame parks it crisply, heading lerps 0.075 per frame.

Motion budget
VERY HIGH
Needs
modelled low-poly 3D world and characters (Draco geometry) UV-mapped to one palette atlas, plus face sprite sheets
Sites
9 · 4 live
Records
10 validated constants
Nearest
rounded-frame-diorama: same toy-3D vocabulary but warm, one crafted diorama walked by scroll; here you traverse freely in loud candy colour.

For Brief is 'a world exists and you should want to be in it' with a real loop — play, explore, role-play — to justify traversal replacing scroll.

Not for Pastiche when content needs SEO/a11y/deep-links/conversion (empty-DOM trade); a game-skin with no playable loop; multiplayer as decoration; real content on a walkable sphere — no URLs, no back button.

Full spec
Motion budget
Everything is real-time: physics character, following camera and sun, blinking NPCs. 113 tween call sites, 69 linear: the linear curve set is physics carrying the feel, not low volume.
Temperature
Candy over cool fog #93a2bf: sky #81BFBC, ink #363a3c, accent #66BDE6, #f3c258 #c25959
Type
Physical type: extruded 3D letters in-scene; MSDF in-world copy (UglyDave-Alternates dialogue, REM-Medium nametags) — free substitutes: UglyDave-Alternates → Patrick Hand
Motion
Mostly linear — ease 'none' (linear) 69x vs inOut1 11x; physics carries the feel. House eases: inOut1 cubic-bezier(.5,0,.1,1), inOut2 cubic-bezier(.56,0,0,1).
Sequencing
No sections: one continuous walkable place, wayfinding by diegetic cues (quest arrows, NPCs, road paint, a held map); scene swaps are a diagonal white wipe (out 1.15s, in 2s inOut1) plus flash.
Varies by
Traversal agency vs surviving chrome: Bruno's physics car, zero chrome → Messenger in-canvas UI → Kode diorama-menu → Oat watch-and-choose

blackbox-keyline-hud

No document: a black full-viewport canvas stage where emissive content is the only light, the interface is hairline HUD keylines in tracked micro-caps, and navigation is camera travel.

Signature move Scroll flies the camera down a helix of panels (50deg steps, radius 3.8) via a framerate-normalised chase lerp of .2; click locks the rail and dives in over 700ms easeOutCubic.

Motion budget
VERY HIGH
Needs
A live WebGL scene whose content emits the light (3D work panels, video, particles); the HUD needs a world beneath
Sites
8 · 2 live
Records
31 validated constants
Nearest
glacial-slate-telemetry: shares hairline keylines, but grades real expedition photography with real data; this is a synthetic, emissive WebGL void.

For Briefs where a live WebGL scene IS the content — immersive showcases, museums, launch experiences; low density, exploration over findability.

Not for Pastiche when: HUD chrome over a flat page with no live scene beneath; content-dense or must-be-found material; stock three.js+GSAP rebuilds; hardcoded chrome white (must be per-scene tokens).

Full spec
Motion budget
Whole frame moves: live scene in permanent drift, scroll dollies the camera down a rail, followers chase-lerp, RGB shift keyed to scroll delta; 64 of 115 counted ease calls are Sine/Cubic out.
Temperature
Cold void: near-black #0e1215 → blue-green #192a2c edge haze; white .3-alpha chrome
Type
NB Architekt: tracked micro-caps 9–15px / 0.1em for all labels + one 110px hairline display cut; nothing mid-size — free substitutes: NB Architekt → Space Grotesk
Motion
Camera travel on a waypoint rail, 700ms easeOutCubic into panels; framerate-normalized chase lerps; permanent slow drift; easeOutSine and easeOutCubic
Sequencing
No sections or document: projects sit in world space on a descending helix; scroll dollies the camera panel to panel, entering above the first, sinking below the last; click dives in, scroll closes.
Varies by
How much chroma the void allows and what emits: Orano's lone chartreuse pointer → Xbox's five-hue legend → V6/V4's dichroic-neon spectra.

overscale-grotesk-whiteout

One grotesk at billboard scale cropped by the viewport, a bimodal scale (display vs ~11px caps), achromatic two-value chrome; photography supplies 100% of the color; sections invert whole grounds.

Signature move Each billboard line wipes up out of its own mask as the slide enters — 1.5s cubic-bezier(.075,.82,.165,1), +0.1s per line — and leaves faster on .6s cubic-bezier(.65,.05,.36,1).

Motion budget
MEDIUM
Needs
Commissioned campaign photography or a photographed physical object; the imagery supplies every hue, the chrome none
Sites
6 · 4 live
Records
4 validated constants
Nearest
colorfield-poster-grotesk: both use viewport-scale grotesk and whole-ground swaps, but its colour is painted flat fields; here only photos carry colour.

For Sites fronting commissioned campaign photography or a photographed physical object — foundries, studios, portfolios — where imagery earns 200px of empty ground.

Not for With stock photography it reads unstyled, not restrained; in product-is-colour categories (food, fashion, cosmetics, paint); anywhere a mid-scale subhead, second face, or accent hue is needed.

Full spec
Motion budget
One curve, not little motion: 15 hero lines mask-wipe in (1.5s, +0.1s per line) across 4 carousel slides; 29 data-scroll-speed parallax layers; the one ease recurs 90× on links, header, burger.
Temperature
Cold neutral #1c1c1c/#fff to warm bone #fcf6f4/#100f0f (ali-ali); always one pair
Type
One grotesk sitewide (Neue Montreal variable), 12.5rem/200px lh 1, edge-cropped; heading ramp hollow 3.125→8.75rem — free substitutes: Neue Montreal → Inter Tight
Motion
Per-line mask wipes, asymmetric easing — enter 1.5s cubic-bezier(.075,.82,.165,1), exit .6s cubic-bezier(.65,.05,.36,1); survives with zero animation library
Sequencing
Held photo plate, type wiping over it; next section = whole-ground ink/ground flip, never a divider; below the fold density collapses (Pangram: font-card grid; Bennett Clive: unaligned image index).
Varies by
Motion substrate deforming the billboard word, 2018→2024: WebGL displacement → marquee → GSAP scroll → pure CSS transitions (pangram)

colorfield-poster-grotesk

Silkscreen-poster logic on scroll: flat saturated colour fields with viewport-scale grotesk in black/white ink, hierarchy from scale and ink discipline alone, and whole-ground hard swaps per section.

Signature move Scroll crosses a section seam: the ground cuts instantly to the next flat colour while the fixed chrome re-inks over .2s, fired by a 1px marker at the header line (42px at 1800 design width).

Motion budget
MEDIUM
Needs
Client-owned flat artwork, archive drawings or photography + real long-form copy (Getty: catalogued Gehry sketches)
Sites
5 · 4 live
Records
11 validated constants
Nearest
blend-mode-swiss-poster: its incident comes from a fixed WebGL blend/glitch layer; here the whole poster is flat CSS/SVG with a hard ground swap per section.

For Editorial, cultural and archive subjects; brand or exhibition sites with real long-form to carry; clients who own strong flat artwork or photography.

Not for Poster screens without a reading system say nothing; bracket-mono labels alone = generic 2023 tic; synthetic squiggles = decoration; one shadow/gradient/rounded card collapses the conceit.

Full spec
Motion budget
Grounds never animate (hard cut). Motion lives in the display word — sticky scaleY scrub to 0.3 over 170vh, pointer-damped glyphs at speed 3 — plus a .2s chrome re-ink and 8 loader loops.
Temperature
Flat and printed; #ffa441 #16a147 #4596ff #ff6359 fields, pure #000/#fff ink
Type
Three voices, no mid-sizes: ultra-black grotesk at viewport scale, serif for all prose, mono 500 uppercase at 12/14px.
Motion
Hard ground cut at the seam, never crossfade; chrome re-inks over .2s; sticky scale-scrub squashes the poster (ease:none); Lenis duration .6s
Sequencing
Each section owns one flat ground; the next arrives as a hard colour cut, never a crossfade. Colour-field chapters alternate with theme=light essay sections; [READ MORE] collapses long prose.
Varies by
Ink chroma: achromatic + one red emblem → near-black/white on colour → second pigment (brown on amber) → 40%-opacity tinted mono

Signature move Props live in the headline's depth: idle sine.inOut yoyo (±20° yaw/±8° pitch, 3s each way) under a 2s pointer tween (ny/10, nx/20 rad) as scroll carries glyphs in front of and behind them.

void-specimen-stage: one lit object in a dark room under a moving camera; here props sit on a flat single-hue page, layered in depth with the type.

For Agency/studio statements, single-product launches, brand monuments — one idea fills a viewport and the brief has more 3D budget than copy.

Not for Neue Machina + chrome plus-blocks lifted whole is 2022–23 period costume; flat props on a flat field without material value-work; 2090vh tracks on pages with copy to read; hidden-h1 depth hacks.

Full spec
Motion budget
All 3D always moves: every prop idles (3s-each-way yoyo) under a 2s pointer tween while scroll scrubs one camera over 8 waypoints on a 2090vh track. Small amplitude, not small volume.
Temperature
Cool pales to hot flats: periwinkle #c9d2e7 / WebGL 0xCAD6EC, vermilion #ff5043, #dbdad9→#fff
Type
Oversized uppercase grotesk (Neue Machina) on a hard pixel ladder 30–120px, line-height:100%, irregular word gaps — free substitutes: Neue Machina → Unbounded
Motion
Two-speed: idle sine.inOut yoyo, 3s each way (6s period) (±20° yaw/±8° pitch) under a lagging 2s pointer tween, riding a scroll-scrubbed camera walk (2090vh track)
Sequencing
One idea per viewport on one continuous camera walk: 8 named waypoints chained in vmin on a body-triggered score (~200-vmin legs, mostly 5-vmin holds); DOM copy toggles play/reverse, never scrubbed.
Varies by
Prop meaning: pure volume (noomo) → gesture/desk objects → literal SKUs (silencio); hue and occlusion direction vary independently.

Flat-vector characters at high density own the page — cropped by the viewport — over saturated grounds that hard-swap wholesale per section; chrome whispers in pills, motion bounces, never fades.

Signature move Everything that arrives or is touched overshoots, never fades: letters pop scale .8→1 on elastic.out(2, 0.5), stagger .07s; hovered pills squash 1.05→.96→1 in 300ms.

flat-sticker-pop: same dead-flat saturated grounds but no mascot cast (ruling); rounded sticker primitives. Here bespoke characters own the page.

For Playful consumer brands with bespoke character art — beverage/snack e-com, mascot-led products, sites where a detour delights rather than blocks a task.

Not for Without a real illustrator — stock or generated flat-vector collapses into 2019 corporate-Alegria; on text-heavy layouts (copy stays off color fields); on task-completion flows like checkout.

Full spec
Motion budget
High: 58 looping Lottie character animations in 17 viewport-gated groups, 27 elastic tweens, 27 scrubbed tweens incl. a 400vh WebGL can tumble; pill hovers squash.
Temperature
Loud warm childlike: marigold #ffd372, sky #88c1f8, bubblegum #f6b1cf on cream #fef7e6
Type
One grotesk (Neue Montreal, 3 weights); UI clamp(15px,1.31vw,25px) vs display clamp(80px,23.2vw,446px) — ~18:1 scale — free substitutes: Neue Montreal → Hanken Grotesk
Motion
Elastic-only: 27 elastic eases in 11 tuning strings (GSAP clamps amplitude to >=1, so fewer distinct curves), zero back/bounce/fades; hovers squash to scale 1.05 then 0.96, back to 1, in 300ms; scrubs ease:"none"
Sequencing
Colour is the navigation: each section/state is a saturated room (whole ground swaps, .3s delayed under a cover) with its own in-view character loops; pages change under a click bloom + Lottie wipe.
Varies by
Where the carnival is authored, how ground is addressed: data-attr/token CSS repaints + vector engines → one field + physics → raster plates.

Signature move Switch SKU (nav click, drag or 5s autoplay): ground, panel, button, ink and shadow repaint in one ~1s beat (DOM: cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1); canvas ground RGBA-lerped), restarting from current.

Motion budget
MEDIUM

one commissioned focal object per SKU (rendered 3D or photo) as an alpha PNG with a baked contact shadow
Sites
4 · 3 live
Records
9 validated constants
Nearest
prop-occluded-grotesk: also one flat hue + object + big grotesk; flavor-swap requires a full repaint bound to a variant attribute on switch (p2 ruling).

For Multi-SKU/flavor product lines with a small hand-picked palette set and budget for one commissioned hero object per SKU — beverages, produce, records.

Not for Without commissioned per-SKU objects — stock 3D/flat vector collapses it to startup-blob; past a small hand-picked theme set (generated palettes = arbitrary rainbow); multilingual single-script face.

Full spec
Motion budget
Concentrated at the SKU switch: 1s full-field repaint, word stretch and a 2x0.5s underline, plus a 5s autoplay countdown; the field itself never modulates. No motion census in sources.

Candy, warm-biased: mint #8bd3b9, salmon #f7987c, marigold #ffb700, magenta #e34f7f
Type
One viewport-scale word drawn through the object: Sailec Regular white, 9.9vw/13.125vw, line-height:1, no kicker — free substitutes: Sailec → DM Sans

Swap repaints all slots in one beat: 1s cubic-bezier(.645,.045,.355,1) + RGBA-lerped canvas clear, restart from current colour; 2-phase quint nav underline (0.5s quint.in, then 0.5s quint.out)

cg-diorama-poster: same baked CG walkthrough and hairline chrome, but flat type in one saturated hue; here type inherits the render's warm light.

Not for Needs an authored world: over stock or generic renders the display serif reads as perfume ad and the family collapses into beige emptiness. No ENTER gate or auto-advance without narration worth it.

Full spec
Motion budget
The whole frame moves: scroll drives a full-bleed camera through 6 chapters (Apadana ≈15.7 capped viewports). DOM motion is sparse: one title at each stop. One ease limits curves, not volume.

Each chapter is its own route and camera clip: travel → dwell (title/hotspot exist only in the gap) → travel. Seams hide in fog (2s ramps; 2.1s-out/3.7s-in wipe); ordinal filigree counter + 3px rail.
